Decisions.implementation_detail: Keep existing program/name/memberships; no architecture completion. Shared approved code corrections must list cross-program effect.

Decisions.approved_value: Exclude departments 43,44,45 / college 20
Decisions.implementation_detail: Includes المدني والرسم الهندسي; later explicit whole-institute exclusion supersedes earlier inclusion. Keep names/rows; create no programs/plans.

Decisions.implementation_detail: Earlier 74-credit/ESI228 decisions retained only as history, not executable scope. Keep college/departments.

Decisions.subject: software institute excluded

Decisions.implementation_detail: Keep its name and existing data.

Decisions.subject: student scope
Decisions.approved_value: All existing and future students in included programs
Decisions.implementation_detail: Use audited plan assignments. Do not pretend new_students_only satisfies this; blocked students remain blocked and are reported. Do not edit old registrations/results/decisions.

Decisions.subject: administration source
Decisions.approved_value: Original SRC01 DBMater; 82 credits
Decisions.implementation_detail: TIF125 remains أساسات العلاقات العامة, TIF226 القانون التجاري, TIF211 الإدارة المالية.

Decisions.subject: accounting additions
Decisions.approved_value: Use SRC05 82-credit accounting plan; shared law TIF226 and finance TIF211
Decisions.implementation_detail: Use program 42. Preserve each program recommended placement; do not create duplicate common courses.

Decisions.subject: FIE221 identity
Decisions.approved_value: One shared course: معادلات تفاضلية / تحليل رياضي (4)
Decisions.implementation_detail: Preserve one course ID and both reference labels; no duplicate or invented equivalence.

Decisions.subject: TIF125 contact hours
Decisions.approved_value: 2 theoretical + 2 practical; 3 credit hours
Decisions.implementation_detail: Explicit user correction, not a formula converting contact hours to credits.

Decisions.subject: historical safety
Decisions.approved_value: No deletion, grade rewrite, recalculation or fabricated equivalence
Decisions.implementation_detail: Resolve identity before hours. Only codes explicitly approved for correction have that authority; do not silently relabel used subjects.

Decisions.subject: electives
Decisions.approved_value: Choice-slot rows are budgets; alternatives are separate
Decisions.implementation_detail: Keep existing valid alternatives, include reference sports alternatives; never create X/slot courses or sum all pools as required credits.

Decisions.subject: missing contact hours
Decisions.approved_value: Blank means unknown, not zero
Decisions.implementation_detail: Use nullable supported fields; do not infer theory-only delivery, 60/40 marks or equivalence from the blank. Report remaining unknowns.

Decisions.subject: all-student blockers
Decisions.approved_value: Existing writer/transfer guards remain enforced
Decisions.implementation_detail: Identify narrow completion gaps, such as unavailable pre-completion progress, with explicit safe semantics/tests. No general force flag or direct assignment-table bypass.

Decisions.subject: reference collisions
Decisions.approved_value: Unconfirmed same-name matches are candidates
Decisions.implementation_detail: Keep PSB321-326 in the source special-education plan; no automatic move/merge of PSC counseling subjects. Source is approved for membership, not proof of cross-program equivalence.

Decisions.subject: SQL privacy
Decisions.approved_value: Latest SQL is evidence for private isolated checks
Decisions.implementation_detail: Do not commit raw dumps, student records, attachments or database secrets. No production execution.

Decisions.subject: delivery
Decisions.approved_value: New branch, one Draft PR to develop
Decisions.implementation_detail: No merge or deployment. Preview default; mutation requires --apply and actor/revision/manifest identity.

Decisions.subject: sports source precedence

Decisions.implementation_detail: ES223 athletics(1) belongs to department; TS221 administration belongs to college despite prefixes. TS222 combat(1), TS223 swimming, TS213 gymnastics.
